subject: English
passage: Far from being recent innovations, ______ more than 2,000 years ago.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: concrete was developed by Romans in the ancient empire
choices.B: Romans in the ancient empire developed concrete
choices.C: the development of concrete by Romans in the ancient empire occurred
choices.D: the ancient empire was home to Romans who developed concrete

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. Modifiers and their subjects must go next to each other. The modifier "far from being recent innovations" must be describing "concrete," because that is the only possible innovation in this sentence.
